metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: MEBMIT crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C118 H165 Cd10 O90 Tb9,C118 H163 Cd10 O89 Tb9,3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb4 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb5 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb6 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb7 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb8 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Cd1 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd2 (Cd) has 8 O neighbors; Cd3 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd4 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd5 (Cd) has 6 O neighbors; Cd6 (Cd) has 6 O neighbors; Cd7 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd8 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd9 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd10 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Tb10 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb11 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb12 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb13 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb14 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb15 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb16 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb17 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb18 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Cd11 (Cd) has 6 O neighbors; Cd12 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd13 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd14 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd15 (Cd) has 6 O neighbors; Cd16 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd17 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd18 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd19 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors; Cd20 (Cd) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 73 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.433-4.727 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 84.18-133.69°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula {[Cd10Tb9L8(OH)16(OAc)23(H2O)3][Cd10Tb9L8(OH)16(OAc)23(H2O)4]}·3H2O (HL = 3-ethoxysalicylaldehyde). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 16 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 23 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 16 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 23 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(I), I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
